overview: Norwood Family is a private family history app where members explore their family tree, claim their own profiles, contribute photos and archive items, and stewards govern the family record.
features: Explore the family tree and heritage branches
Contribute photos and archive items to family history
Family Stewards review claims, relationships, and archive contributions
Manage stewards, successors, duplicate profiles, and relationship administration
Archive and restore profiles safely with a full audit history
